description: This file contains unit tests for the CanvasIPCTests, specifically testing JSON encoding/decoding of requests related to canvas presentation within the OpenClawIPC module. It defines a test struct with two test functions that verify the proper serialization and deserialization behavior.

classes.name: CanvasIPCTests

methods.name: canvas present codable roundtrip
